name: install-first-launch-demo
capture: Actual Android package installer and app on a clean emulator. The APK was copied to Downloads; on a phone it comes from the website download.
limits: Recorded on an emulator, not a phone
Install and first-start waiting times shortened
Debug build of the Pro edition; the Core edition shows the same installer
editing: Waiting removed; staging accelerated 6x and installing 12x. Android status bar replaced with chapter labels.

scenes.label: 01 / APK IN DOWNLOADS / ANDROID DEMO
scenes.en: The Q-P1NG APK in Downloads, as after downloading it from the website.
scenes.it: L’APK di Q-P1NG in Download, come dopo averlo scaricato dal sito.

scenes.label: 02 / OPEN THE FILE / ACCELERATED
scenes.en: Tap the file: Android prepares the package.
scenes.it: Tocca il file: Android prepara il pacchetto.

scenes.label: 03 / UNKNOWN SOURCE / ANDROID
scenes.en: Installing outside Google Play: Android asks you to allow this source once.
scenes.it: Installazione fuori da Google Play: Android chiede di consentire questa fonte una volta.

scenes.label: 03 / ALLOW FROM THIS SOURCE
scenes.en: Turn on Allow from this source, then go back.
scenes.it: Attiva Consenti da questa fonte, poi torna indietro.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 1 OF 6
scenes.en: Private chats, useful tools and ways to connect offline.
scenes.it: Chat private, strumenti utili e modi per connettersi offline.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 2 OF 6
scenes.en: Encrypted messages and calls over Tor, with identities you can verify.
scenes.it: Messaggi e chiamate cifrati via Tor, con identità che puoi verificare.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 3 OF 6
scenes.en: Nearby contacts without internet. LoRa and VHF need compatible hardware.
scenes.it: Contatti vicini senza internet. LoRa e VHF richiedono hardware compatibile.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 4 OF 6
scenes.en: Notes and files in the encrypted vault; face protection before sharing images.
scenes.it: Note e file nel vault cifrato; protezione dei volti prima di condividere le immagini.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 5 OF 6
scenes.en: Download AI models when you need them; local AI then works offline.
scenes.it: Scarichi i modelli AI quando servono; poi l’AI locale funziona offline.

scenes.label: 07 / WELCOME / 6 OF 6
scenes.en: Q-Feed: share with contacts or in public, and check the audience before sending.
scenes.it: Q-Feed: condividi con i contatti o in pubblico, controllando il pubblico prima di inviare.
